items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: my friend also said, “Why don’t you get up there and play with Lester Young?” So I got up to play and Lester Young tapped me on the back and said, “Go ahead, kid, blow.”

ctx.x: Did you get into swing from the radio or just because your brother was out there doing it?

More from the radio and then of course his was more of a Swing Era, and I grew up with I guess 15 or so, in 1945 or before, I used to hear Lester Young and Charlie Parker and things, Lennie Tristano, and I grew up more with that new influence. And then of course after it came the Coltrane, after me. So yeah, I grew up with that. So I kind of went hey this is interesting, and I kind of was interested in that.
Did you ever get with your brother and say hey, check out this bop, come on, get with it.
